info.description: Trust Intelligence API - Entity verification and risk scoring

post.description:
Full entity trust check.

Triggers all available data sources based on provided identifiers,
computes a trust score, assigns a cluster, and returns a recommendation.

Provide at least one identifier: kvk_number, cbe_number, domain, iban, or vat_number.

post.description:
Create a new API key for self-service provisioning.

Only free and sandbox tiers can be created directly.
For paid tiers, create a free key first then POST /v1/keys/upgrade/{tier}.

Returns the plaintext key exactly once. The key cannot be retrieved
after this response - only a SHA-256 hash is stored.

post.description:
Verify a PaymentPayload without settling.

Accepts base64-encoded PaymentPayload JSON (same as PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header).
Returns {isValid, payer, invalidReason, ...} without recording or settling.

Used by clients to pre-validate before submitting to the protected endpoint.

Co-sign and broadcast a payment transaction.

Accepts x402 spec request format:
  - paymentPayload: base64-encoded PaymentPayload (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value)
  - paymentRequirements: PaymentRequirements object (from PAYMENT-REQUIRED header)

Also accepts legacy format:
  - payload: PaymentPayload JSON
  - raw_transaction: base64 partially-signed Solana VersionedTransaction

For EVM payments, triggers settlement via on_chain_settlement.settle_evm_payment.
Returns SettlementResponse-compatible JSON.

pending_settlements.title: Pending Settlements
pending_settlements.description: Pending rows still inside the sweep's retry budget (in-flight). Rows the sweep cannot rebuild into a payment are charged the same budget (#246), so they drain to exhausted_settlements rather than sitting here forever

exhausted_settlements.title: Exhausted Settlements
exhausted_settlements.description: Pending rows whose sweep_attempts reached MAX_RETRIES: credited, never settled, no longer retried. Not included in pending_settlements

failed_settlements.title: Failed Settlements
failed_settlements.description: Ledger rows the startup sweep resolved to FAILED (#196). These are no longer counted by pending_settlements, so without this they would disappear from the health view entirely.

uncollected_usdc.title: Uncollected Usdc
uncollected_usdc.description: USDC credited to the ledger that will never settle: exhausted PENDING plus FAILED rows (#359). Reconciliation work, expressed as money rather than as two row counts.

settlement_configured.title: Settlement Configured
settlement_configured.description: True when the EVM settler would run (SETTLEMENT_RPC_URL and SETTLEMENT_PRIVATE_KEY both set). EVM leg only; see solana_settlement_configured for the other leg. When False, EVM rows stay pending indefinitely

solana_settlement_configured.title: Solana Settlement Configured
solana_settlement_configured.description: True when the Solana settler would run (SOLANA_RPC_URL and SOLANA_FEE_PAYER_PRIVATE_KEY both set). All three settlement counters above are chain-mixed, so both flags must be read to know whether they are trustworthy. When False, Solana rows stay pending indefinitely
